One. You hear a boy talking about a club.
I like taking photographs because I can show people small things they do not usually notice. My favourite picture is of a tiny flower.

Two. You hear a teacher.
You do not need a perfect voice to join our singing group. We can all learn together. Beginners are welcome.

Three. You hear a girl leaving a message.
Hi Lucy, can I use your camera on Friday? My camera does not work. I will give yours back after the club.

Four. You hear a boy in the music room.
The noise is very loud out here. Can you shut the door? Please keep playing; I just want the corridor to be quieter.

Five. You hear an announcement.
Tonight’s school play starts at six, not seven. You can come in from half past five. Please have your ticket ready at the door.
